Using the Laplace transform identity  
\[
\int_0^\infty e^{-sx}\sin x\,dx=\frac{1}{s^2+1},
\]
we have  
\[
\int_0^\infty x^2 e^{-sx}\sin x\,dx=\frac{d^2}{ds^2}\left(\frac{1}{s^2+1}\right)
=\frac{2(3s^2-1)}{(s^2+1)^3}.
\]
Evaluating at \(s=1\):
\[
\frac{2(3-1)}{(1+1)^3}=\frac{4}{8}=\frac12.
\]
